subtitle: Super game developer Aurely has fallen into a deep worry. Her game Friends Ochunsung was a huge success, but lately the number of new users has plummeted. The cause was that the stage gap between new users and existing users was too large. Pondering how to solve this problem, she decided to adjust the difficulty by dynamically extending playtime. Being a super developer, she implemented most of the logic easily, but ran into a crisis when it came to calculating the failure rate. Complete the code that calculates the failure rate for Aurely.
